sources.scope: 1988 section of a page covering all World Finals 1977-1997
sources.evidence: Page 'The Early Years - World Finals Champions' (compiled by Marsha Poucher, as of 7 Dec 2007) lists each year's top places; the 1988 ACM Contest Finals entry, February 24, 1988, Atlanta, Georgia, gives ranks 1-4.

contest_facts.value: 1 Caltech (Gillespie, Greenblatt, Goodman, Hemphill); 2 Carnegie-Mellon; 3 Univ. of Pennsylvania; 4 Harvard

notes: Source 1 is a series-wide historical list (not the contest's own site), so the web role looks wrong; only the 1988 entry is relevant. It is a compilation, so arguably second-hand. Source 2 has no copy.
